newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GINOLA STAYS AT NEWCASTLE SAYS KEEGAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GINOLA STAYS AT NEWCASTLE SAYS KEEGAN.

text.p: Newcastle manager Kevin Keegan has dismissed speculation that David Ginola will be allowed to leave the English club.
The flamboyant French winger was linked with moves to Arsenal and Barcelona during the close season and has complained that his role has become more defensive in the current campaign.
But Keegan said on Thursday that the player he bought from Paris St Germain for 4.5 million pounds ($7.05 million) last year, was staying.

"I could have sold him in the summer, everyone knows that, but I didn't buy David Ginola to make a profit," Keegan told BBC Radio. "I like him and I think he will adjust to English football better in his second season.
"He's a fantastic talent and it's just a case of harnessing his talent into the team."
